title: service executive
description:
SERVICE EXECUTIVE
   

  

 Job Code
   

  

 JOB000880
   

  

 Designation
   

  

 SERVICE EXECUTIVE
   

  

 Business Vertical
   

  

 Oxygen
   

  

 Key Responsibility
   

  

* Diagnose, troubleshoot, and repair mobile phones, laptops, and related electronic devices.
* Perform chip\-level and component\-level repairs (where applicable).
* Replace defective parts such as displays, motherboards, batteries, and connectors.
* Ensure all repairs are done in compliance with brand and company quality standards.
* Accurately record job details, parts used, and repair status in the O2 Care system.
* Maintain proper handling of customer devices to avoid damage or data loss.
* Assist in software updates, data backup, and formatting activities.
* Coordinate with the service coordinator for pending jobs, spare parts, and escalations.
* Ensure timely delivery of repaired devices within the committed TAT (Turnaround Time).
* Maintain cleanliness and organization in the service area and tools.


 Location
   

  

 KANJIKUZHY
   

  

 State
   

  

 Kerala
   

  

 Country
   

  

 INDIA
   

  

 Educational Qualification
   

  

* Minimum qualification: ITI / Diploma in Electronics / Computer Hardware or equivalent.
* 1–3 years of experience in mobile or laptop repair preferred.
* Brand service center experience will be an added advantage.


 Age
   

  

 20\-40
   

  

**Experience**
 0\-3
   

  

 Salary Range
   

  

 Best In industry
